[Story]
College student Li Lei plans to go to Europe for a free trip during the summer vacation. He saves some money for this, and looks for travel guides, prepares to buy plane tickets and book hotels. Then his friend Xiao Wang tells him that a charity organization is going to some poor areas in Africa to do volunteer service, but needs to raise some funds. Li Lei is very moved and decides to participate in this activity.

[Question]
After Li Lei participates in the volunteer activity, what does he do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Li Lei no longer plans to go to Europe for a free trip.
B. Li Lei goes to Europe and Africa at the same time.
C. Li Lei continues to plan to go to Europe for a free trip.
D. Li Lei plans to work for the charity organization in the future.
